### ✨ New
- 📻 RTL-SDR sticks with a Fitipower FC0012 tuner now work (about 22 to 948 MHz)
- 📊 Spectrum analyser: a long press on a move button switches between coarse moves (half the screen) and fine moves (a twentieth)

### 🐛 Bug fixes
- 🎧 Listen: sliding to the edge of the spectrum no longer makes the frequency run away; held at the edge, it moves a step at a time

### 🧰 Other
- 🗣️ The debug log now follows DMR decoding during a call, to find why voice can stop
